notes.title: Mystery March Update [0.0.13]
notes.content:
Hi, everyone! Look, I got the Mystery March update done just in time for the month to end. Imagine releasing it in April. How silly! This content update is themed around the Mystery aspect. It was added last and therefore wasn't as fleshed out as the others.

[h1]The Big Stuff[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45500667/a964836a276e8eb3e64b41b1e276f8f3cad35010.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45500667/4d47eec6f1d1c6dde16c88d2c43eb1707c9bea41.png[/img]

[h2]New Mystery Content[/h2]
[list]
[*] 3 new animons: Najmagi, Escurida, Zabilula
[*] 4 new animancers: Kareem, Khulan, Bhavya, Kareem
[*] several new Mystery tricks
[*] new status condition "Cursed"
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45500667/f37a9e6c9398c5efc40243ea5588e4841718dca5.png[/img]

[h2]Twitch Integration[/h2]
Twitch subscribers of the Sword & Quill channel can now redeem a sub-exclusive animon (Twitchmon) by connecting their account in the settings.

Streamers can enable the Twitch mode with lets viewers interact in several ways:
[list]
[*] suggest which path to take on the map
[*] spend channel points to give the streamer rewards
[*] predict enemy moves during combat to help or hinder
[*] spend Bits to adopt an animon persistently and giving the streamer the option to borrow it
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45500667/7c90235b25741a42e0e6320a9a6e9551f5cefc30.png[/img]

[h2]Elusive Animons[/h2]
You can now encounter very rare versions of some Animons. If you manage to capture them, you permanently unlock their elusive color variant as an option if you have them as a starter option.


[h2]Detailed Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]New Stuff[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added elusive Animons (aka shinies!)
[*] Added Animon: Najmagi (Mystery)
[*] Added Animon: Escurida (Mystery)
[*] Added Animon: Zabilula (Mystery)
[*] Added Mystery tricks
[*] Added Animancer: Kareem
[*] Added Animancer: Khulan
[*] Added Animancer: Bhavya
[*] Added Animancer: Lana
[*] Added Mystery condition "Cursed"
[*] Added Twitch integration
[*] Added upgrade: Chest Rerolls
[*] Added upgrade: Hammam Rank
[*] Added upgrade: Elusive Chance
[*] Added Companion Shards (picking your own starters by capturing animons with the companion shard)
[*] Added new soda: Soula Energy + new Soda art
[*] Added to status-condition heal items
[*] Added release option screen when capturing animon while party is full
[*] Added resetting settings to default
[*] Added mouseover feedback to map nodes
[*] Added status condition info to trick tooltips
[*] Added more battle effects
[*] Added notification icon to main menu for new upgrades available
[*] Added poison battle effect
[*] (TTS) Added support for trick swapping on Animon details screen
[/list]

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed mouse hover behavior on starter Animon card buttons
[*] (Controller-Mode) Fixed inconsistent code input selection on starter screen
[*] Condition Tweaks and Fixes
[*] Fixed stun effect still showing after Animon swap
[*] Fixed being able to pay enemy tricks
[*] Fixed some adaptive tricks starting as readied
[*] (TTS) Fixed Inventory error
[*] Fixed dicebag loadout not resetting when starting new run
[*] Fixed tutorial dice cost issue
[*] Fixed adding Squirt multiple times in tutorial
[*] Fixed enemy intelligence adaptive bug
[*] Fixed Fatesworn for enemy
[*] Fixed transition and battle UI wrong on anything non 16:9
[*] Fixed upgrade cost
[/list]


[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Replaced Asinember's art
[*] Implemented enemy intelligence considering grow
[*] Lowered Hypnotize stun probability to 50%
[*] Changed Tide to also apply when rolling equal to Tide amount
[*] Save data migration for old starter upgrades to companion shard upgrade
[*] Refactored Bindshard probability calculation + tooltip info
[*] Reduced critical damage from x2 to x1.5
[*] Tweaked tooltips to dynamically load condition infos
[*] Changed Brace tag to Rigid
[*] Changed condition icons to hand-drawn ones
[*] Changed scoring system
[*] Added score to Currency Display component
[/list]

notes.title: Marbleous Update - Patch 0.0.12
notes.content:
A new content update is here and now you get to spend your hard-earned marbles on persistent upgrades. You might notice that some things you know are missing, like starting items or the Fusion option in the Hammam (formerly Kiosk). Those are now upgrades that you can buy now, among other things like unlocking additional starters.

Not that marbles from a run only transfer when the run is over (finished or game over). Adding an "abort run" option is on my list.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45500667/b0aeffda3f10f4a313edc8accbbf91262286213d.png[/img]

But since I don't like taking things away from you without giving you something as well, here's a special starter that you can unlock with the code SQRRL282. There's a code input button now on the starter selection screen.

Additionally, some terms got renamed to fit better into the vibe of the game:
[list]
[*] Techniques are now [b]Tricks[/b]
[*] Types are now [b]Aspects[/b]
[*] Battle Tags are now [b]Flavors[/b]
[/list]

[h1]New Stuff[/h1]

[b]Collection Screen[/b]: You can now see which animons, stickers, and tricks you have collected so far and how many are still missing. Note that tricks only get counted when an animon learns or knows them, not by just having the item in the inventory.

[b]"Entropy" effect[/b]: When payin a mystery trick with a Mystery die, a random die gets rerolled


[h3]New Items[/h3]
[list]
[*] Status condition heal items for Burning, Poison, and Tide
[*] Exp Bindshard: Animons captured with this bindshard immediately receive a chunk of exp
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes & Tweaks[/h1]

[h3]Tweaks[/h3]
[list]
[*] inventory items are now sorted by category in following order: Consumables, Bindshards, Tricks
[*] added tutorial dialogue to dicebag to explain new dice effects
[*] added bonus effects (like double, stoke, grow) to buffs too
[*] added stoke and grow visual effects
[*] money and sticker balancing
[/list]

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] (TTS) added missing "closed" prompt on inventory screen
[*] (TTS) fixed data collection popup not reading
[*] (TTS) added support for dice exp rolling and level up
[*] fixed some instances where the battle gets stuck in the "wait" phase
[*] fixed heal percent not calculating correctly
[*] re-added critical chances for some tricks that somehow reverted to 0 (sneaky goblins!)
[*] fixed issue where excess exp was lost when level up reached
[/list]
